title: a field read before a write through the same place plus an unversioned return pin PROVED `result && !result`
origin: fix f1ec77ab75: P1 (a bare read sealed to the entry sentinel) and P2 (the return pin stamped at its statement) close this program

the residuals R-a..R-e of that KH entry are other programs (R-a, R-d precision losses; R-b a per-row overstatement; R-c's field-store member closed by 7f118dfc1f; R-e a counterexample that is not an execution). None is this reproducer, and none is in the corpus yet (README, Not in the corpus yet)

trust-vc-syn.n/a: the reproducer and twin carry trustc's native `ensures` clause between the signature and the body, which is not Rust syntax; trust-vc-syn parses the file with syn and cannot read it at all (`parse verification source file: expected curly braces`), so it has no verdict to give on either side

rustc_flags_note: store 9192 panics after it has emitted every row of a crate holding an `ensures` function (`trimmed_def_paths` called, diagnostics were expected but none were emitted; exit 101), the twin alone included. -Ztrim-diagnostic-paths=false changes only how diagnostics print paths, and the rows are the same with and without it.
